rationale: The brevity, quiet tone, concrete recall and warmth about the repair fit the persona's decreased verbal productivity and low-key style. Several things make the dialogue feel scripted, though. The timer anecdote and the phrase 'felt good' recur almost word for word across turns 3, 4, 6 and 7. Turns 9 and 10 give nearly identical answers. Some answers read as close paraphrases of profile text rather than natural speech, such as the polished self-analysis in turn 12. The patient also volunteers prepared facts when asked open questions, which conflicts with the stated difficulty deciding what to mention. Turn 5 gives a general routine when asked specifically about yesterday. Overall the dialogue is moderately authentic, with noticeable unrealistic repetition and profile-mirroring.
